name: Xipe Totec
title: The Flayed One
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The Flayed One represents conflicting elements that feed one another, such as war and agriculture, death and sustenance, opposing seasons. Indirectly, he symbolizes the core of Omeyocan faith: power from sacrifice. Thus, the existence of realms that function differently is not only a cosmic danger but, for him, a personal affront, driving him to lead battles against them and terrify their worshipers.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Increase this hero’s Divinity by 1% for each stack of [Bleed] that was activated. Strong Hits also increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 5%.
If this hero gain’s an Extra Turn, reset the Core Ability.

skills.name: Haemorrhage
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 395%ATK with a 75% chance to place 2 stacks of [Bleed] on the target. Strong Hits place 3 stacks instead.

skills.name: Ritual Flay
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 565%ATK with an 80% chance to place 3 stacks of [Bleed] on the target then attack all enemies 325%ATK. If the initial target has 10 stacks of [Bleed] the second hit will activate all stacks of [Bleed] on all targets.

awakening_bonuses.description: Increase this hero’s Divinity by 1% for each stack of Bleed that was activated. Strong Hits also increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 5%.

skills.name: Flayed Feast
